'''Ewyrin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] student of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. She was once tempted by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], and later successfully entered and exited a state of [[Meditation of Emptiness|Emptiness]].
